plugin.name: scottland
plugin._long: Spatial window layout: windows scale down toward the side rails and snap into widgets.

option.name: center_width
option._long: Width of the full-scale center zone, as a percentage of the screen width.

option.name: rail_width
option._long: Width of each widget rail at the far left and right, as a percentage of the screen width.

option.name: min_scale
option._long: Scale of windows where the continuous zones meet the widget rails (and on the rails).

option.name: max_scale
option._short: Largest scale in the side zones
option._long: Scale of windows where the continuous zones meet the center zone. Below 100%, windows animate down to it when they leave the center.

option.name: blend_width
option._long: Width of the band just outside the center zone where the scale eases smoothly from 100% into the scale curve, instead of changing abruptly at the edge.

option.name: scale_curve
option._long: Scale across the continuous zones as points "t:scale", t from 0 (center zone edge) to 1 (widget rail), joined smoothly. Empty: straight line from max_scale to min_scale.

option.name: key_remaps
option._long: For apps whose app-id matches, turn one key combination into another before bindings and the app see it.

entry.name: apps
entry._long: Regular expression matched against the focused app-id (case-insensitive).

entry.name: from
entry._long: Key combination, e.g. CTRL+W (xkb keysym names).

option.name: release_bindings
option._long: Run a command when a key is released.

entry.name: key
entry._long: xkb keysym name (e.g. Super_L) or code:N.

entry.name: command
entry._long: Command to run when the key is released.
